system.description:
Make an improvised melee weapon from materials at hand with a Smarts Check; the Smarts symbols rolled set its quality (Improvised Weapon, p136: Smarts, Close, Tier 1/2/3 = 2/4/6 Sharp). It can Malfunction (p132): if you fail a Strike with it and roll at least 1 Strange symbol, it may break or backfire.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.45
system.summary: Make an improvised melee weapon from materials at hand with a Smarts Check; the Smarts symbols rolled set its quality (Improvised Weapon, p136: Smarts, Close, Tier 1/2/3 = 2/4/6 Sharp). It can Malfunction (p132): if you fail a Strike with it and roll at least 1 Strange symbol, it may break or backfire.

automation.onSuccess: Make an Improvised Weapon; its tier equals the Smarts symbols rolled (max Tier 3).

automation.note: Smarts symbols: 1 = Tier 1 (2 Sharp), 2 = Tier 2 (4 Sharp), 3+ = Tier 3 (6 Sharp). Add the matching Improvised Weapon (Tier N) item (Smarts, Close). It Malfunctions only when you fail a Strike with it and roll at least 1 Strange symbol; then roll on the p132 table. It may break or backfire.
